appName: Frontline Strike - VR FPS Shooting Game
displayName: Frontline Strike - VR FPS Shooting Game
display_name: Frontline Strike - VR FPS Shooting Game
display_long_description:
Frontline Strike VR, a fast-paced military shooter built exclusively for Meta Quest.

Deploy into industrial battlefields filled with warehouses, container yards, factories, and tactical combat zones where danger can appear around every corner. Stay alert, use cover wisely, and engage hostile forces in thrilling firefights that test your accuracy, awareness, and combat instincts.

Take command of a growing collection of weapons, including assault rifles, submachine guns, and pistols. Reload manually, aim with precision, and react quickly as enemies push your position from multiple directions. Every encounter demands skill, strategy, and fast decision-making.

Whether you're advancing through enemy territory, defending key positions, or hunting down opponents across the battlefield, Frontline Strike VR delivers immersive first-person action designed specifically for virtual reality.

FEATURES

• Immersive VR military combat
• Realistic weapon handling and manual reloading
• Assault rifles, SMGs, and pistols
• Challenging AI enemy soldiers
• Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All modes
• Multiple industrial combat environments
• Tactical gameplay focused on positioning and accuracy
• Competitive scoring and progression
• Optimized exclusively for Meta Quest

From close-quarters engagements to long-range firefights, every match offers a unique combat experience. Learn the battlefield, master your weapons, and prove yourself as an elite frontline operator.

Suit up, lock and load, and prepare for battle.
